تفتضخون (form VIII)
# تَفْتَضِخُونَ (taftaḍiḵūna) /taf.ta.dˤi.xuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# تُفْتَضَخُونَ (tuftaḍaḵūna) /tuf.ta.dˤa.xuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
